messages.subject: Order of draggable absolutePanels
parts:
Hi,

I have an app with multiple draggable absolutePanels. The order in which they are "stacked" is fixed. I would like the most recently dragged  to always show on top of any other draggable panel, much like program windows behave on a PC.

Is there a way to prevent situations like the below, where the right panel was just dragged on top of the left, but always ends up being displayed beneath?

(My app has big graphics and multiple panels with dynamic sizes, so space is tight...)

Thanks!
